blocks.text: MORONG, Bataan — Pangasinan 2nd District Rep. Mark Cojuangco blamed the national government for dragging its feet on nuclear energy, saying he was disappointed by the lack of firm resolve to operate the Bataan Nuclear Power Plant (BNPP) in this coastal town. Speaking before a group of reporters who toured the BNPP facilities on Thursday, Sept. 24, Cojuangco also blamed the media for its apparent indifference to the nuclear issue. He criticized Bataan Gov. Jose Enrique Garcia III and Bataan First District Rep.
